description: Detailed accounts in Judaeo-Arabic in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yosef. Items in the first section include: white lead; containers of kohl; bamboo chalk. Dated 2 Jumādā II. The next section opens "for me, delayed (? ʿaqqāb; also possible this is a name) with Ibn Muʾmil." The following section also mentions Ibn Muʾmil and gives the date of Sunday 6 Jumādā I; then Wednesday the 9th; then Sunday with 10 days remaining in the month; the bottom section may refer to "my brother"; and the 1th of Jumādā II; Mūsā; and Sunday with 11 days remaining in the month. Verso again refesr to Ibn Muʾmil; Yosef; a bale of lac; the jāliya payment; flax; brazilwood; Mūsā again. At 90 degres there is a section of amounts owed to someone else.
